meta.title: AcademiQ — Full API Documentation
meta.auth: JWT Bearer Token — include Authorization: Bearer <access_token> on every protected endpoint

sections.title: Authentication
sections.note: All auth endpoints are public (no token required).

endpoints.description: Creates a new academy_owner record and the first Users record (role = owner) in a single transaction.

frontend.notes: On success: store tokens, redirect to /dashboard.

endpoints.description: Authenticates against either academy_owner (owner login) or Users table (staff login). Returns JWT pair.

frontend.notes: On success: store access + refresh in localStorage, store user object in AcademyContext, redirect to /dashboard.

endpoints.description: Returns a new access token using a valid refresh token.

frontend.notes: Called automatically by the Axios response interceptor when any request returns 401. If refresh also fails, clears tokens and redirects to /login. Not triggered by a user action.

endpoints.description: Blacklists the refresh token. Requires valid access token.

frontend.notes: handleLogout() — clears localStorage tokens, calls this endpoint, redirects to /login.

responses.200: Updated academy object (same shape as GET).
